library.intro: Platform templates are read, never edited. To change one, duplicate it into your org: the copy is independent, so no later platform change reaches it — which is exactly what makes improving a platform template safe.
library.platformIntro: Managed by the platform admin. Every org sees them; no org writes them.
library.platformEmpty: No platform templates of this kind yet.
library.orgIntro: Built by duplicating a platform template or starting blank.
library.orgEmpty: Your org has not created a template yet.
library.moderatorNotice: You can read the templates. Creating and editing them is an org admin's act.
library.schemeHint: A template carries no colour scheme: a certificate is issued light or dark by what is chosen for its session, and the cards show your organisation's brand.
library.posterScheme: Posters are generated dark, on your brand's gradient.
library.orgEmptyTitle: Your organisation has no templates yet
library.orgEmptyDescription: Copy a platform template to adjust it in the studio, or start from blank.
library.phoneEditNote: Editing in the studio needs a wider screen; on a phone templates are reviewed, not edited.

card.lockedHint: A locked region cannot be moved, resized, hidden or deleted in the org editor. The verification QR and the signature block are locked on every certificate template: a certificate whose QR someone dragged off the page cannot be verified, and that only shows up after it is printed and handed over.

templates.brandNote: Templates carry no open books, graduation caps, lightbulbs, icon libraries, emoji or photography. The visual language is the Knowledge Network: connected dots, thin silver lines, light. And no colour is written out in a template — colours bind to the org's brand kit, and the database refuses anything else.
